title: althaea lavateriflora var. kirrindensis
intro: Althaea lavateriflora var. kirrindensis, commonly known as the 'White Marsh Mallow', is a variety of the Marsh Mallow plant, belonging to the Malvaceae family. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and aid in wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Althaea lavateriflora var. kirrindensis include its mucilaginous properties, which help to protect and soothe mucous membranes, and its ability to calm digestive issues such as diarrhea and irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
